# Security matrix (generated by tools/gen_security.py)

Every MySQL account has **no table privileges**. A role can only (a) EXECUTE the procedures listed and (b) SELECT the views listed. Inside each procedure the hat is checked again (`int_require_role`) and triggers enforce the rules a third time.

## Procedures (write actions) per role

### OWNER  (account `clinic_owner`)

- `create_staff`: Create a staff member with roles (comma list, no spaces) and credential hash (hashed by the app). Registration
- `decide_approval`: Shared interface. decision APPROVED or REJECTED. The trigger refuses self-approval, system principals and anyo
- `set_setting`: Change one clinic setting (audited with the reason)
- `sp_acknowledge_alert`: Acknowledge an alert (owner, or a person with a valid backup delegation)
- `sp_add_doctor_schedule`: own txn. Add a weekly session for a doctor (weekday 0=Mon..6=Sun) and generate its slots
- `sp_add_ingredient`: Add an active ingredient (master)
- `sp_add_medicine`: Add a catalog medicine (master, audited). schedule_class none/H/H1/X; returnable 0/1
- `sp_add_outside_lab`: Add an outside lab (master)
- `sp_add_supplier`: Add a supplier (minimal master; optional on receipts)
- `sp_apply_discount`: Apply an approved discount/free service as a separate negative line (bill must not be finalized yet; after tha
- `sp_apply_schedule_change`: own txn. Apply or decline a schedule change (never by the requesting doctor). Applying creates a NEW schedule 
- `sp_check_alerts`: Run all alert checks now (also run by a MySQL EVENT as SYS-ALERT): stays over limit, unreviewed/critical repor
- `sp_deactivate_staff`: Deactivate a staff member from today (no deletion). The owner cannot deactivate himself
- `sp_delegate_authority`: Delegate limited approval authority (scope discount | partial_payment | approval_backup | alert_escalation_bac
- `sp_end_role`: End a staff member's role from today (history kept)
- `sp_find_patient_candidates`: Ranked duplicate candidates (tier 1 best). The receptionist confirms; nothing is merged automatically
- `sp_grant_role`: Give a staff member an additional role from today (staff_role is a master row, audited)
- `sp_link_counter_customer`: Human-confirmed, audited link of a counter customer to a patient
- `sp_link_medicine_ingredient`: Link an ingredient to a medicine (combination drugs have several)
- `sp_merge_patients`: own txn. Human-confirmed merge. Per CR-2 event rows are NOT rewritten: the merge log is the redirect (canonica
- `sp_reopen_visit`: Reopen after approval: a reversal row on the closure (the original closure stays)
- `sp_resolve_catalog_review`: Resolve a queued free-text name: mapped / added_to_catalog / rejected
- `sp_revoke_delegation`: Revoke a delegation immediately (decisions already made stay valid)
- `sp_revoke_family_link`: Revoke a link instantly (the link row is untouched; a revocation event is added)
- `sp_send_due_reminders`: Queue (simulated) reminders for dues that reached their promised date; at most one per due per day. Text carri
- `sp_set_price`: own txn. Set a price: closes the previous open price of the item the day before and adds the new effective-dat

## Forbidden-action matrix (each must be refused; run `bash db/tests/forbidden_actions.sh`)

| account | attempt | why it must fail |
|---|---|---|
| clinic_receptionist | `SELECT * FROM diagnosis LIMIT 1;` | no table privileges: reception cannot read diagnoses |
| clinic_receptionist | `SELECT * FROM stock_batch LIMIT 1;` | cost price hidden from reception |
| clinic_receptionist | `CALL sp_record_payment(1, 10, 'cash', @a, @b);` | payments are the accountant's |
| clinic_receptionist | `CALL sp_prescribe_item(1, 1, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, NULL, @a, @b);` | prescribing is the doctor's |
| clinic_nurse | `CALL sp_prescribe_item(1, 1, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, NULL, @a, @b);` | nurse cannot edit prescriptions |
| clinic_nurse | `CALL sp_record_payment(1, 10, 'cash', @a, @b);` | nurse cannot touch billing |
| clinic_nurse | `SELECT cost_price FROM v_stock_by_batch LIMIT 1;` | cost price only for owner and pharmacy |
| clinic_nurse | `UPDATE stock_movement SET quantity_delta = 99 LIMIT 1;` | no direct table writes |
| clinic_doctor | `CALL sp_record_payment(1, 10, 'cash', @a, @b);` | doctor cannot record payments |
| clinic_doctor | `CALL sp_receive_stock(1, NULL, 'X', '2099-01-01', 1, 1, 2, @a);` | doctor cannot change stock |
| clinic_doctor | `CALL sp_administer_dose(1, 'given', NULL, 1, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @a);` | doses are recorded by nurses only |
| clinic_pharmacy | `CALL sp_clinical_signoff(1, 'x', @a);` | pharmacy cannot sign off clinically |
| clinic_pharmacy | `CALL sp_record_payment(1, 10, 'cash', @a, @b);` | pharmacy records counter-sale payments only |
| clinic_pharmacy | `DELETE FROM dispensing LIMIT 1;` | dispensing records can never be deleted |
| clinic_accountant | `CALL sp_prescribe_item(1, 1, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, NULL, @a, @b);` | accountant has no clinical rights |
| clinic_accountant | `SELECT * FROM clinical_note LIMIT 1;` | no table privileges |
| clinic_owner | `UPDATE audit_log SET reason = 'x' LIMIT 1;` | audit log is insert-only, even for the owner |
| clinic_owner | `DELETE FROM payment LIMIT 1;` | payments are append-only |
| clinic_owner | `CALL sp_administer_dose(1, 'given', NULL, 1, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, @a);` | owner cannot edit doses given |
| clinic_family | `SELECT * FROM patient LIMIT 1;` | family link account reads only family views |
| clinic_family | `CALL sp_record_payment(1, 10, 'cash', @a, @b);` | read-only: no write procedures |
